1.model: F315: native three-input regression + player forecast byes / matched NIG
1.mean_method: week-specific native three-input regression centered on observed league YTD PPG; forecast-week same-roster bye losses
1.weekly_volatility: league-wide normalized weekly SD; residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean
1.strength_uncertainty: week-specific persistent Normal team offset, residual-matched to the bye-adjusted mean

potential_points.validation: 2023 selection; rolling 2024-2025 holdout; residual downward bias remains

1.description: All forecasts use one scoring model. Current Potential PPG and prior GM performance estimate team scoring ability, anchored to league YTD PPG. Future-week bye adjustments use the selected week’s roster and estimated player scoring, allowing for eligible replacements. Weekly scores follow a fitted Normal-inverse-Gaussian distribution with a persistent team-strength offset. H2H, Playoffs and all five Bonus Games share the same simulated scores.
